    • login

      public Message login(String username) throws RemoteException
      This method is used to log in a player, it expects a username and returns a message with an error or confirmation
      Specified by:
      login in interface RMILoginInterface
      Parameters:
      username - the username of the player
      Returns:
      a message with an error or confirmation, confirmation consist in OK, errors can be USERNAME_TAKEN or GENERIC_ERROR
      Throws:
      RemoteException - if the connection is lost
